description:
How does the CAMO Marksman tool work for installing deck boards?

 In this video, Jeff demonstrates how to use the CAMO Marksman hidden fastener system and explains why it’s one of the best tools for building a clean, professional-looking deck.

The CAMO Marksman tool is designed to create consistent spacing between deck boards while fastening them from the sides, eliminating visible screws on the surface. Jeff walks through how to set up the tool, install deck boards correctly, and avoid common mistakes when building a deck.
If you're building a deck and want a faster installation process with a cleaner finish, this guide shows how the CAMO system compares to traditional top-down screwing methods.

In this video:
• How to use the CAMO Marksman tool
• Hidden fastener deck installation method
• Proper deck board spacing
• How to get a clean, screw-free deck surface
• Tips for faster and more accurate deck installation
